company.name: Stipple Bio
company.shortDescription: Stipple Bio is a biotechnology company that offers cellular profiling and target discovery with epitope resolution.
company.description: Stipple Bio is a biotech company that focuses on advancing cellular profiling and target discovery using epitope-level resolution technologies. It develops proprietary platforms that analyze cellular interactions, enabling researchers to identify precise therapeutic targets for drug development. The company’s approach is particularly applied in oncology, where it aims to discover tumor-specific cell surface epitopes to create safer and more effective treatments. Its “Pointillist” platform is designed to map these epitopes with high precision, helping overcome limitations of traditional therapies such as off-target toxicity.
